objective: Exceed annual new customer orders target and reduce cost per new order
targeting: Multi-Category, Electricals & Home Tech, Flexi Pay and brand-trust growth personas

planning_priorities.label: Autumn/Winter launch and Black Friday-Christmas trading peaks
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Maximise sales impact of the September new-season launch and the Black Friday/Christmas trading peak; plan activations early and focus on efficiency, attention and incremental new customer orders.

planning_priorities.label: World Cup summer context
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No incremental tentpole budget for the World Cup; combine June/July budgets with contextual, fixture-aware TV and CTV creative around the summer sale rather than blanket inflation.

planning_priorities.label: 'Make a Statement' creative platform
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Support the brand-trust platform launch without a fundamental media strategy change; maintain phasing towards proven campaign tactics while building consideration and trust.

planning_priorities.label: Multi-Category household growth opportunity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Demonstrate a combined strategic comms and media approach for incremental Multi-Category (fashion, home and electricals) household growth within the existing budget.

planning_priorities.label: Electricals & Home Tech growth opportunity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Support Freemans' Electricals & Home Tech range around new-season browsing and Black Friday/Christmas trading moments; incremental budget considered above the base media budget where the case is strong.

planning_priorities.label: Affiliate/Cashback conversion defence
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No broad above-the-line promotional push planned for 2026, but paid search and journey investment can be used tactically to defend basket-to-order conversion if affiliate CPC rises.

planning_priorities.label: Channel role clarity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Provide clarity on OOH, audio, CTV, Paid Search, Paid Social, Display and partnerships/content roles.

planning_priorities.label: Commercial opportunity strategy
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Review media savings/value beyond guarantees and consider direct media-owner deal opportunities.

planning_priorities.label: 2026 testing framework
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Agree a testing framework based on Multi-Category, Electricals & Home Tech and Flexi Pay growth opportunities in collaboration with media investment and insight teams.
